_comment: The VectorEdge HRMS biometric ingestion contract, as built on the HRMS side in
Unlike default.json this is NOT a template: it is a real, working contract, so
attendance_path is populated and the bridge will enable sync with it as-is.
Load it on the HRMS Configuration page, set the base URL and the API key, and
Two things the bridge deliberately does NOT send:
* verification_type — EmpAttendanceLogs has no column for it, and 81% of
observed punches report status=4, whose meaning is not settled between the
two firmware families in use. A guessed label in an attendance ledger is
* a date, an hour, a minute or a second — only the UTC instant. HRMS derives
the attendance day and the wall clock from it using the tenant timezone.
Web check-in does the opposite (the browser supplies both) and that is why
its write path and read path disagree either side of midnight.

tenant._comment: No tenant header: the tenant is resolved server-side FROM the API key, so the bridge cannot assert one.
